title: Annenin paltosu

characters.MOM: a mother in her early forties with long dark hair in a braid, wearing an old faded brown wool coat
characters.GIRL: a little girl of about eight with short black hair, wearing a bright red puffer jacket
characters.OLDMOM: the same mother, now in her sixties with grey hair in a braid, wearing the same old faded brown wool coat
characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about twenty-eight with short black hair, wearing a red wool coat

scenes.text:
Annenin paltosu kaç kışlık,
hiç düşündün mü?
scenes.prompt: On a snowy winter morning, {MOM} in her old faded coat walks {GIRL} to school, snow falling softly, warm street lamps still on.

scenes.text:
Senin her kış
yeni bir montun oldu.
scenes.prompt: In a small living room in winter, {GIRL} spins happily in her new red jacket while {MOM} sits on the sofa watching her with a tired, warm smile, lamp light, snow outside.

scenes.text:
Onunki hep aynı kaldı;
"Bu daha sıcak" dedi.
scenes.prompt: In the evening by a window, {MOM} sits in lamp light sewing a button back on her old faded brown coat laid across her lap, snow falling outside.
Years later, on a snowy street, {OLDMOM} in the same old faded brown coat walks slowly under falling snow, glowing street lamps, quiet and calm.

scenes.text:
Bu kış paltoyu sen al.
Bunu annene gönder; bu kış onun olsun.
scenes.prompt: On a snowy evening at the door of a small house, {WOMAN} wraps a new soft cream colored coat around the shoulders of {OLDMOM}, who smiles with tears of joy, warm light from inside.

caption:
Annen üşüyor mu?

Annen hep kendini en sona koydu. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder; bu kış onun olsun.
